title: InsideBias: Measuring Bias in Deep Networks and Application to Face Gender Biometrics
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its findings are focused on how biases related to ethnicity and color affect the internal activations of deep neural networks in face and digit recognition tasks, and proposes a method called InsideBias to detect such biases with few samples.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It analyzes bias in deep learning models for gender and digit recognition, focusing on ethnic and color-based biases.
